title: National Parks Road Trip Planner Printable, Multi Park Itinerary, Reservation Tracker, Travel Budget Planner, Road Trip Checklist PDF
description:
Planning a road trip through several national parks? This 32-page fill-in workbook keeps the whole trip in one place: the route, honest drive days, every timed entry, permit and campsite, passes and fees, the budget, and the one hike that matters at each stop.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Dream list and a route grid, one row per park
- Honest drive days: how many hours of driving still leave time to hike, with a daylight check
- Trip overview and a large route sketch page to read in the car
- What needs booking and when, plus a reservations tracker for timed entry, permits, campsites and rooms
- A print, fold and tape pocket for tickets and passes
- Passes and fees: single-park passes vs the America the Beautiful pass, extra fees for nonresidents at busy parks, the Parks Canada Discovery Pass
- Lodging plan, 6 park stop pages and a daily plan page
- Budget planner with a fuel helper in mpg and L/100 km
- Fuel and long empty roads, car kit checklist, day pack checklist for each stop
- Weather, closures and plan B
- Crossing the border, and a before-you-go checklist for the USA and Canada
- Meal and grocery planner, kids and pets on a park road trip
- Trip log, parks visited stamp page and notes

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Reservations, timed entry, fees and road closures change every year. Always check the official park and booking sites for your dates before you book. No maps or GPX files are included. Not affiliated with the National Park Service or Parks Canada. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
